tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: 0x Blue, the signature. Same value in both themes: 4.58:1 on `ground` white AND 4.59:1 on `ground` black. Fill of primary buttons with `on-blue` text; links and accent words on `ground`; a white button with `blue` text. On `mist`, `blue-soft` or any grey surface use it only for text 19px bold / 24px+ and icons - small text there takes `blue-strong`.

tokens.name: blue-strong
tokens.usage: Small blue text on tinted grounds (`mist`, `blue-soft`): 7.9:1 light, 5.3:1 dark. Also the pressed state of a `blue` button in the light theme.

tokens.name: blue-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind selected rows, chips and info notes; words on it in `blue-strong`.

tokens.name: gradient-start
tokens.usage: Gradient top-right stop (= `blue`). The brand gradient: linear-gradient(to top right, `gradient-end`, `gradient-start`).

tokens.name: gradient-end
tokens.usage: Gradient bottom-left stop. White `on-blue` text holds 4.58:1 at the light end and 9.0:1 at this end.

tokens.name: on-blue
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `blue` and on the gradient, in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Main text (the brand black is pure #000000 - the only black that keeps `blue` above 4.5:1). Light: 21:1 on `ground`, 18.4:1 on `mist`. Dark: white text.

tokens.name: grey
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, labels, values. 7.5:1 on `ground`, 6.6:1 on `mist` (dark: 9.3:1 / 8.1:1).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Placeholders, disabled text, timestamps and other meta. 3.0:1 on `ground` light, 4.5:1 dark - never for text people must read to act.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background: white in light, pure black in dark.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs and grouped boxes on `ground`. Lighter than `muted`, blue-biased so it sits with `blue`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers (0.5-1px), input borders at rest, slider tracks, and the fill of DISABLED buttons (visible on ground and on mist).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind popups and sheets.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. 4.6:1 on white and black grounds.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Success, received money, positive change. Icons, dots, chart marks and large fills (3:1 rule).

tokens.name: green-text
tokens.usage: `green` for words on `ground` and on `green-soft` (4.5:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: green-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background for green notes, badges and rows; words on it in `green-text`.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Errors, sent money, destructive actions, negative change. Icons, dots, chart marks and large fills (3:1 rule).

tokens.name: red-text
tokens.usage: `red` for words on `ground` and on `red-soft` (4.5:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: red-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background for red notes, badges and rows; words on it in `red-text`.

tokens.name: purple
tokens.usage: Highlights, new or premium features, a second chart series beside `blue`. Icons, dots, chart marks and large fills (3:1 rule).

tokens.name: purple-text
tokens.usage: `purple` for words on `ground` and on `purple-soft` (4.5:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: purple-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background for purple notes, badges and rows; words on it in `purple-text`.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Warnings and pending states. Text on a `yellow` fill is always `ink` black (11.3:1), never white. Icons, dots, chart marks and large fills (3:1 rule).

tokens.name: yellow-text
tokens.usage: `yellow` for words on `ground` and on `yellow-soft` (4.5:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: yellow-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background for yellow notes, badges and rows; words on it in `yellow-text`.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Attention that is not an error: limits, fees, expiring items. Icons, dots, chart marks and large fills (3:1 rule).

tokens.name: orange-text
tokens.usage: `orange` for words on `ground` and on `orange-soft` (4.5:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: orange-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background for orange notes, badges and rows; words on it in `orange-text`.

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: Information, links to outside resources, a third chart series. Icons, dots, chart marks and large fills (3:1 rule).

tokens.name: cyan-text
tokens.usage: `cyan` for words on `ground` and on `cyan-soft` (4.5:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: cyan-soft

webProfiles.note: Web profiles version 3. Shared colors/fonts stay unchanged. Pick a presentation or work pattern first; each field uses CSS pixels unless a token name is specified. Native apps and slides retain their own type and geometry.

selection.mixedPage: A hero may be spacious and a data region compact. Do not inherit hero spacing into the data region.

spacious.purpose: Presentation, storytelling and clear primary calls to action.
rules: Use whitespace to separate narrative sections.
Content-driven heights; do not add empty rows or fixed card heights merely for alignment.
Body copy max width 680px; this does not constrain data tables.

compact.purpose: Scan, compare and act on more useful information in the available viewport.

layout.contentWidth: fluid; optional product-specific max width, no mandatory 1200px cap

rules: Keep data text at least 14px; reduce padding and chrome before reducing typography.
Row sizes are minimums; task text, multilingual labels and two-line values may grow without clipping.
32px table rows are for single-line desktop data; use 40px as the mobile starting point.
Use aligned columns and line separators instead of a rounded card for each datum.
No placeholder rows to fill panels. No fixed panel height purely for symmetry.
Limit height only for intentionally scrollable lists; measure the number of useful visible records and avoid nested scroll traps.
Two-column mobile panels require sufficient content width; verify at 320px, 360px, 390px and in all supported languages. Allow full-width panels for long labels/forms.

Toolbar titles and controls stay on one row when the product requires it. Compact controls first; use the existing 20/18/16/14 type scale. If full labels still cannot fit at 14px, use approved short labels or an overflow menu. Do not silently shrink data text or lose actions.
32px controls describe the visible shape. On touch devices provide a non-overlapping target of at least 44px using the surrounding layout; increase control size where this cannot be achieved.
Use shadow-y2 only for floating overlays or intentionally elevated panels, not every row and toolbar control.
Desktop data columns align by meaning: labels left, numbers right, headers aligned with their column. Do not reorder data solely to fit a decorative grid.
Standalone compact actions follow their panel width or content; the 296px native-app button rule does not apply.

taskWorkspace.structure: Grouped flat list; one project row with metadata and task region. Phase label is a column beside the task, not an extra vertical section.
taskWorkspace.mobile: Project metadata above; phase and task remain side by side. Show all task text and preserve all links.

dataWorkspace.structure: One data surface with aligned headers and cells, content-measured columns, and internal horizontal scroll if necessary.
dataWorkspace.overflow: Keep important compound values on one line. Measure their full width; do not reduce text size or let data overlap adjacent cells.

principles: Choose the layout pattern before choosing spacing.
Preserve content and actions at every supported width.
Reduce nested surfaces and duplicate labels before reducing font size.
Use color only for identity, state, or a meaningful metric.
Shared component roles use shared geometry and typography.
Document product exceptions instead of changing the global defaults.

references.adopted: 4/8/12/16 spacing scale; density is a coordinated component setting.
Content-aligned cells, 8px compact padding, separators and selectable surface treatment.
A task workspace uses a coherent list/table region, not a grid of decorative cards.
32px dense desktop rows, 40px default rows; choose density consistently. Product-specific 56px headers are an explicit exception, not a Carbon rule.

surface.shadow: shadow-y2 only for floating overlays or explicitly elevated surfaces

interaction.motion: Color/focus feedback only; no shifting cards or changing text width on hover.

content.equalPanelHeight: Only where explicitly required by a product; long contents scroll inside the fixed region.

palette.note: Existing approved cat-eye yellow is a product override; global 0x Blue palette remains unchanged.

valuation.ath: start -> end (xN), N = end/start from unrounded values; one line, gain in orange-text weight 600
valuation.note: Shared 56px table/panel headers and fixed 328px panels are explicit user requirements, overriding generic compact defaults.

toolbar.note: Approved product-specific one-line toolbar; do not apply its 32px visible shape as the general touch target rule.

workspace.note: Shared by Valuation and Work. User approved Linear direction; yellow-soft highlights DAILY rather than generic card headers. Preserve Valuation 8 rows, fixed 328px panels and existing panel columns.

sharedComponents.note: Applies to CV, Valuation and Work. Profiles change density, not component identity. CV retains spacious section/hero spacing and body typography. Avatar/language switch stay circular; overlay dialogs retain radius16.
